abandonRaisedBed.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Create one production game operation icon for Gredice. References supplied: the seedling for the appearance of living cultivated plants, the backpack and first harvest award for rendering style. Match chunky low-poly beveled volumes, clear broad facets, matte tactile finish, warm upper-left light, deep shaded sides, strong 48px silhouette. Use dark cocoa soil, honey-orange timber boards, warm amber and charcoal metal tools, bright broad lime leaves for desired crops, darker olive narrow jagged foliage for weeds, and ochre straw/dry material. Elevated three-quarter view with enough height to see the soil. Operation: freeing a raised bed for return and reuse, after removing all plants and equipment. The largest object is one visibly COMPLETELY EMPTY honey-timber raised bed with a clean flat dark soil surface, no plants or debris in the bed. Behind the rear right corner, completely outside the raised bed, a compact low wooden carry crate tilts toward the camera to reveal the removed sturdy short bamboo stakes, a large loop of jute tying cord, and two thick blank pale plant labels. A single gathered dry stem protrudes beside the accessories to suggest end of season. The crate remains clearly distinct from the planter and smaller than half its footprint. Use enough dark open soil to show a clean reset. No rake or other working tool, plants, straw mat, gate, or decorative imagery. Center the whole near-square isolated illustration with at least 7% clear margin on every side. True transparent alpha outside the scene. No people, hands, lettering, text, numbers, arrows, symbol overlays, background field, extended ground, tiny decorative details, particle effects, or cast shadows outside the illustration.
abandonRaisedBed.export: Center the illustration on a transparent 640 × 640 canvas with 14% padding per edge on the longest axis. Encode as WebP at quality 90.
